## Batch 21 authored

I added the finite CPTP channel schedule and its well-definedness proof, completed the assigned noise and threshold arguments, and updated the A/B pages, manifest, dependency levels, source coverage, and proof contracts. The A page now has 19 items; the B page has one example.

I also corrected the correlated-noise definition after reading AGP §4.1: fault sets and fault-map choices may be correlated, but each CPTP map remains attached to its own location. The cited model does not support an arbitrary joint channel across distinct locations. The local-stochastic witness and threshold proofs use the corrected scope. [AGP §4.1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/quant-ph/0703264)

**Eight items are ready; twelve are escalated.** QC20 suppliers needed by the gadget and planar-code claims fail renderer YAML validation; two also contain multiline display math. The explicit universal-gadget proof and the disjoint-witness reduction for overlapping exRecs remain unsupplied. Exact affected IDs and evidence are in the [cross-batch dependency record](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/quantum-computing-algorithms-60-2026-10-15-batch-21.cross-batch-dependencies.json) and [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/quantum-computing-algorithms-60-2026-10-15-batch-21.notes.md).

**Scoped checks passed:** proof layout (20 items, 47 steps, 0 defects); precheck (13 proof-bearing items, 0 failures); strict proof contracts (20/20, 0 errors); rendercheck (22 files, 0 errors); content policy (20 items, 0 errors); focused depcheck (0 errors or warnings); source fetch (4/4 verified). The whole-run item-level check still has 48 empty inventories and 7 stale labels outside this batch. The batch dependency check stops on malformed QC20 YAML.

Eight ready records were written with `step1-decisions.mjs record`. That command could not create escalations because hashing their QC20 dependencies fails on the malformed YAML. I recorded the other twelve as escalated without owner overrides; per-item decision validation confirmed 8 ready and 12 escalated. The run remains blocked at `1-scaffold`, 14/60 covered, with additional run-level blockers recorded in the notes. The authored records are not independent approval.
